item.title: HIV Vaccine Candidate Triggers Rapid Neutralising Antibodies
item.description: A novel HIV vaccine candidate induces neutralising antibodies after a single dose in primates, potentially accelerating HIV prevention strategies. The post HIV Vaccine Candidate Triggers Rapid Neutralising Antibodies appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Botanical Extracts Add Little, Raise Toxic Elements
item.description: Botanical extracts provided negligible nutrition however could increase element exposure; inorganic arsenic and lead were concerns. The post Botanical Extracts Add Little, Raise Toxic Elements appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Early-Stage Knee Osteoarthritis Shows Underloading
item.description: Early-stage knee osteoarthritis may involve knee underloading, with lower second contact force peaks during barefoot walking. The post Early-Stage Knee Osteoarthritis Shows Underloading appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Serving Size Information Often Fails Snack Shoppers
item.description: Serving size information on packaged snacks rarely matches front-of-pack cues, limiting portion guidance in supermarkets today. The post Serving Size Information Often Fails Snack Shoppers appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: One-Third of Dementia Cases Linked to Non-Brain Diseases
item.description: Study shows non-brain diseases such as diabetes, hearing loss, and liver disease, account for nearly one-third of dementia cases worldwide. The post One-Third of Dementia Cases Linked to Non-Brain Diseases appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Atopic Dermatitis Linked to Higher Global Burden of Asthma and Rhinitis
item.description: Global analysis finds people with atopic dermatitis have significantly higher rates of asthma and rhinitis, highlighting the need for integrated respiratory screening. The post Atopic Dermatitis Linked to Higher Global Burden of Asthma and Rhinitis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Vunakizumab Shows Promise for Active Psoriatic Arthritis
item.description: A phase 2 trial found vunakizumab improved ACR20 response rates in active psoriatic arthritis, with sustained benefits and a favourable safety profile. The post Vunakizumab Shows Promise for Active Psoriatic Arthritis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Asthma Microbiome Patterns Vary Worldwide, Study Finds
item.description: Global research shows asthma microbiome and airway inflammation differ by region, but neutrophilic asthma shows consistent bacterial patterns. The post Asthma Microbiome Patterns Vary Worldwide, Study Finds appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Momentum grows for Europe’s ePI transition
item.description: A landmark European report offers a comprehensive analysis of electronic Product Information (ePI) pilot projects. The post Momentum grows for Europe’s ePI transition appeared first on European Medical Journal.
